name: bestpred
description: USDA's best prediction of dairy lactation yields (BESTPRED): 305-day and mature-equivalent milk, fat and protein, reliability and persistency from a cow's or a herd's test days.

interface.longDescription: USDA's best prediction of dairy lactation yields, run on your computer: 305-day and mature-equivalent milk, fat and protein, reliability and persistency from a herd's DHI or DairyComp test days, or one cow's. Codex runs USDA's method instead of estimating the numbers.
defaultPrompt: Work out 305-day milk for every cow in tests.csv
Which cows in this herd are the least persistent?
What is this cow's mature-equivalent 305-day milk from her test days?
